label: Scythian constructivist
summary: Poster-led product direction using Soviet Constructivism, WPA public graphics, Art Deco geometry, aged paper, red, black, gold, and faded blue.
audience: campaign site, visual archive, product dossier, poster-like web interface
mood: Bold, archival, public-communication graphics, diagonal, dramatic, material.

frame.objective: Turn the sketch into a poster-like interface with huge type, dossier cards, and a cinematic archive structure.
frame.layout: Use diagonal geometry, strong modular blocks, red/black/gold hierarchy, and visible paper texture. Preserve the sketched placement before adding style.
frame.motion: Use parallax poster layers, hard-cut section reveals, and subtle print registration shifts.
frame.assets: Reserve large poster-image slots for AI-generated archival imagery, symbols, portrait cutouts, maps, and public-notice graphics.
frame.mobile: Stack as poster panels with preserved headline dominance, short dispatch cards, and cropped image layers.
